scope_note: This is the first component of Freud's 1923 tripartite definition and is kept separate from its therapeutic and disciplinary components.
statement: In his 1923 encyclopaedia article, Freud defined psychoanalysis in one sense as a procedure for investigating mental processes that were otherwise difficult to access.
statement_zh: Freud 在 1923 年的百科條目中，將精神分析的一層意義界定為探究其他方式難以觸及之心理歷程的程序。
